description: One YAML, whole agentic pipeline. `source: + steps: + outputs:` — 15 ops (llm_call, route, conditional_route, debate, critique_loop, synthesize, mcp_call, tool_use_loop, handoff, map, extract, classify, reduce, self_reflect, sub_pipeline). Typed named `inputs:` on every text-emitting op for multi-input joins by port name. First-class partition fields (`partition_type` / `partition_start` / `partition_values` / `dynamic_partition_name` / `partition_dimensions`) mirror sibling ml_pipeline / polars_pipeline / warehouse_pipeline. LiteLLM-backed for LLM ops.

inputs.description: Source text — literal, url, file, or upstream_asset (kind = literal|url|file|upstream_asset). Or omit and let an `mcp_call` step drive the pipeline directly.

outputs.description: One or more first-class asset outputs (declared via outputs.assets: [step_ids]); each is a dict `{text, ...op-specific fields}`. Plus optional text / json sinks.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted asset names. Each step listed in outputs.assets becomes '{prefix}_{step_id}'.

source.label: Source
source.description: Data source. kind = literal | file | url | upstream_asset. All string fields are {partition_key}-templated.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps. Each: {id, op, ...op-specific args}. Two wiring modes (compose per step): (1) legacy `source: <step_id>` reads that step's text into `{text}`; (2) typed `inputs: {port: {from: step_id} | {literal: value}}` — each port becomes a `{port_name}` placeholder in prompt_template / system_prompt (and, for mcp_call, in string tool_args). 15 ops available: llm_call | route | conditional_route | debate | critique_loop (optional `until_score_gte:` for adaptive termination) | synthesize | mcp_call | tool_use_loop | handoff | map (fan-out LLM per item in a list) | extract (structured JSON via output_schema) | classify (text → label from fixed set) | reduce (LLM-fold over chunks) | self_reflect (one-shot draft+critique+revised) | sub_pipeline (invoke inline sub-pipeline as one step). Full per-op JSON Schema is published under manifest agent_hints.steps_schemas (discriminated union on `op`).

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Output declaration. Shape: {assets: [<step_ids>], text_sinks: [{from, path}], json_sinks: [{from, path}]}. `assets:` step outputs become first-class Dagster assets; sinks are side effects. All sink paths are `{partition_key}`-aware.

personas.label: Personas
personas.description: Named reusable LLM sub-configs. Each persona bundles `{model, api_key_env_var, api_base_env_var, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens}`. Reference from any step / sub-config via `persona: <name>`; the persona's fields are merged into the step's config (explicit inline fields ALWAYS win — persona is a defaults-provider). Reference sites: step-level (llm_call, classify, extract, reduce, self_reflect, map, tool_use_loop) and sub-configs (route.router, route.specialists[*], conditional_route.specialists[*], debate.proposers[*], debate.arbitrator, critique_loop.drafter, critique_loop.critic). Personas are inherited into sub_pipeline steps automatically.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for emitted assets. Default: 'agents'.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags for the emitted assets.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type shared by every emitted asset. Omit for unpartitioned. Use `{partition_key}` in source text / URL / file path / sink paths to substitute per partition.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for time-based partition types (daily/weekly/monthly/hourly/multi).

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated string OR list — the fixed partition keys for static/multi partitioning. e.g. ['NVDA', 'TSLA', 'META'] or 'NVDA,TSLA,META'.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name for the DynamicPartitionsDefinition when partition_type='dynamic'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name}. Set INSTEAD of partition_type for multi-dimensional partitioning.

per_step_ops.label: Per-Step Ops
per_step_ops.description: When true, emit as @dg.graph_multi_asset with ONE OP PER STEP instead of a single @multi_asset. Runs page shows N step_keys (`{prefix}_ingest`, `{prefix}_{step_id}` per step, `{prefix}_extract`) instead of one composite op. Native per-op retry via Dagster's re-execution machinery — restart from any failed step. State dict serializes through the IO manager between ops. Default false keeps zero-overhead single-op behavior for high-throughput pipelines.

partition_key_parser.label: Partition Key Parser
partition_key_parser.description: Optional template that inverts composite dynamic partition keys into named fields. e.g. `{owner}/{repo}#{issue_number:int}` — parses `dagster-io/dagster#30000` back into `partition.owner='dagster-io'`, `partition.repo='dagster'`, `partition.issue_number=30000`. Fields are then available as `{partition.<name>}` substitutions in tool_args, prompt_template, system_prompt, source.text, and sink paths. Optional `:int` / `:float` / `:bool` type suffixes preserve types when the substitution target is a pure single-placeholder value (needed for MCP tools that reject string types like GitHub's `get_issue.issue_number`). Pair with `PartitionedAssetLauncherJobComponent` for the config-driven-partition-key pattern.
